oneOf.description:
One fixed-role HTTP transport whose provider-specific behavior is
limited to the pack's pure request and response mappings.

Digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

PaymentMappingCall.description:
One pure mapping pair at a reviewed, origin-relative provider path.
Neither script can select an origin, endpoint role, method, credential, or
retry behavior.

PaymentOperationMapping.description:
Submit and optional read-only status mappings for one typed payment
direction. The host fixes POST for submit and GET for status.

auth.description:
Host-enforced credential mechanism for every endpoint in this payment
direction. Scripts never receive or select credentials.

PaymentProviderAuth.description: Closed credential mechanisms implemented by the fixed-role payment host.

PaymentProviderMapping.description:
The complete executable mapping closure of one data-driven provider.
Scripts are reviewed pack files, never deployment values.

scripts.description: Every Rhai file reachable from the operation mappings, exactly once.

RhaiExpression.description:
A Rhai expression reference: the digest-pinned file from the pack's
script inventory and the precompiled entrypoint to call
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` sections 5.6 and 8.5). Inline code is
refused (CFG-EMBED-1).

entrypoint.description: The precompiled entrypoint the engine calls.

file.description: The script file path, resolved against the pack's script inventory.

ScriptReference.description:
A script seam: code in its own file beside the pack, referenced by a
relative path and pinned by digest (CFG-EMBED-1). Scripts never carry
credentials and never construct URLs; the `http` component builds every
request from its declared template
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 5.6).

digest.description: The `sha256:` digest the file must hash to.

path.description: The script file, relative to the pack document.

mapping.description:
Pure, digest-pinned provider wire mappings. Compiled connectors omit
this member; the generic HTTP connector requires it.
